title: Replace support admin rights with a role-based support view
description: Remove database admin rights from support accounts; give support a role that can read and update orders and contact data only, with no export and no access to D-04
notes: Still open during the Phase 4 incident simulation (deliberate weak spot); Due date brought forward from 2026-12-15 after INC-01 (post-incident review)

title: Enforce MFA for staff and admin access
description: MFA for email, remote access, cloud console, all admin accounts and every account that can reach A-02
notes: KPI-03; Due date brought forward from 2026-12-15 after INC-01 (post-incident review)

title: Database activity logging and quarterly access review
description: Log reads and exports on A-02 per user; review support and admin access every quarter
notes: KPI-04

title: Security awareness training and phishing simulations
description: Annual training for all staff plus quarterly phishing simulations with a report button
notes: KPI-07

title: Monthly authenticated vulnerability scanning with patch deadlines
description: Greenbone scans of A-01 and A-02 every month and after changes; fix within POL-02 deadlines; verify by rescan
notes: First cycle done 2026-11-17 in the Phase 3 lab (Nmap, Trivy, ZAP); monthly cycle continues; KPI-01 and KPI-02

title: Fix injection flaws in the web shop code
description: Parameterised queries, server-side input validation, code review and security tests before release (OWASP ASVS level 2)
notes: Implemented and verified in the Phase 3 lab 2026-11-17: patched login route (bound parameters); same attack fails after the fix (V-01)

title: Web application firewall in front of the web shop
description: Managed WAF with an OWASP core rule set in blocking mode; used for virtual patching
notes: Tested in the Phase 3 lab 2026-11-17 (ModSecurity CRS blocked both injection variants); kept as a compensating layer, not deployed as the fix

title: Separate named admin accounts and a jump host
description: Dedicated admin accounts with MFA, used only through a managed jump host; no shared admin credentials

title: Encrypted immutable off-site backups and quarterly restore tests
description: Add an immutable backup copy in a separate cloud account; encrypt all backups; restore A-02 every quarter
notes: KPI-08

title: Cloud security configuration baseline
description: CIS benchmark baseline for the cloud account; block public access to databases and storage; quarterly configuration review

title: Protect customer logins against credential stuffing
description: Rate limiting, bot detection, breached-password check at sign-up and login, optional customer 2FA

title: Encrypt and manage staff laptops
description: BitLocker full-disk encryption, device management with remote wipe, and endpoint detection and response on all A-04 laptops

title: Supplier role decisions and data processing agreements
description: Decide the GDPR role of A-05, A-06, A-08 and the hosting provider; sign Art. 28 agreements where needed; stop sending email addresses to A-08
notes: KPI-09

title: Incident response plan and breach notification procedure
description: Write the incident response plan and Art. 33/34 procedure under POL-05, and test them with a simulated breach
notes: Exercised in Phase 4 (INC-01): POL-05 procedure, breach assessment, Art. 33/34 texts, breach clock; KPI-05 = 0.02 h

title: Central log collection and alerting
description: Collect security logs from A-01, A-02 and A-04 in a SIEM and review alerts every day
notes: Phase 4: log-based detection on proxy and app logs (tools/phase4_detect.py, rules 1 to 4) detected INC-01 in 18 s; Wazuh SIEM not deployed (time and RAM); KPI-06

title: Protect the checkout page against script injection
description: Content Security Policy, Subresource Integrity for third-party scripts, and monitoring of changes to checkout scripts
notes: CSP and security headers deployed on the hardening proxy 2026-11-17 (V-02); SRI and script monitoring still open; residual style-src 'unsafe-inline'

title: Automated deletion under the retention schedule
description: Nightly job deletes or anonymises data past its retention period; backups expire under POL-07 rotation

title: Data subject request procedure and log
description: Written procedure, request log with deadline tracking, and reply templates
notes: KPI-11

title: Restrict cross-origin access to the web shop
description: Remove the wildcard Access-Control-Allow-Origin header; the shop is same-origin
notes: Hardening proxy 2026-11-17; verified by ZAP baseline rescan (V-03)

title: Block exposed file listings, keys and logs
description: Deny public access to /ftp, /encryptionkeys and /support/logs; move files out of the web root
notes: Hardening proxy 2026-11-17; verified by manual recheck, HTTP 403 (V-04)

title: Upgrade vulnerable third-party libraries
description: Upgrade jsonwebtoken, express-jwt, crypto-js, lodash and the other packages Trivy flags; rebuild and rescan
notes: POL-02: 7-day deadline for Critical findings (V-05); needs source changes outside the lab

title: Emergency block of admin user-data endpoints
description: Proxy rule returns 403 for /api/Users and /rest/user/authentication-details until CA-01 is done
notes: INC-01 containment 17:38:24 UTC; side effect: blocks customer registration (CA-25)

title: Reset compromised support credentials
description: Reset the support account password; replace the shared account with personal accounts under CA-01
notes: INC-01 containment 17:38:22 UTC; replay verified 17:38:27 UTC; undone by the Docker restart at 18:04 UTC (the app re-creates its database at start) and re-applied 2026-11-17

title: Revoke login tokens on password change
description: Invalidate issued tokens when a password changes; shorten token lifetime
notes: INC-01 root cause 4; now required by POL-04 v1.1 statement 10 and POL-05 v1.1 statement 10; not implementable in the lab app (needs code change)

title: Narrow the emergency block to GET requests
description: Allow POST /api/Users (customer registration) again while keeping the admin data block
notes: Implemented 2026-11-17 (nginx limit_except POST); tested: sign-up 201, user-data reads 403 (evidence/phase5/ca25-containment-narrowed.json); POL-05 v1.1 statement 10
